epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce application startup failure rate from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The application backend must successfully run its Flyway migrations against PostgreSQL 15 without syntax errors and report healthy on the /health endpoint.

slices.title: Fix PostgreSQL syntax error in Flyway migration
slices.jtbd: When implementing the database migration fix for this epic, I want to replace the H2-specific CREATE ALIAS syntax with valid PostgreSQL syntax, so that the application startup remediation is achieved
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local Docker Compose environment with PostgreSQL 15
When the backend application starts and runs Flyway migrations
Then it executes successfully without 'CREATE ALIAS' syntax errors
And the /health endpoint returns HTTP 200 OK
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease migration syntax errors from 1 to 0
